'ledger',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'tail',max(version)) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
'origin_fk',(select jsonb_build_object('oid',f.oid,'name',f.conname,'child',f.conrelid::regclass::text,'parent',f.confrelid::regclass::text,'parent_oid',f.confrelid,'child_columns',f.conkey,'parent_columns',f.confkey,'index_oid',f.conindid,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(f.oid,true),'validated',f.convalidated,'deferrable',f.condeferrable,'deferred',f.condeferred,'delete_action',f.confdeltype,'update_action',f.confupdtype,'match_type',f.confmatchtype) from pg_constraint f where f.conrelid=to_regclass('public.webhook_subscriptions') and f.conname='webhook_subscriptions_api_client_id_fkey'),
'parent_key_projections',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema','public','name',v.name,'observed_oid',v.observed_oid,'oid',c.oid,'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'acl',c.relacl::text,'namespace_acl',n.nspacl::text,
 'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('number',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type_oid',a.atttypid,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'collation_oid',a.attcollation,'acl',a.attacl::text) order by a.attnum) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum=any(array(select unnest(f.confkey) from pg_constraint f where f.contype='f' and f.confrelid=c.oid and f.conrelid in(to_regclass('public.webhook_subscriptions'))))),
 'referenced_indexes',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',i.indexrelid,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'nulls_not_distinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'key_columns',i.indkey::text,'key_count',i.indnkeyatts,'total_count',i.indnatts,'opclasses',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',o.pos,'oid',o.oid,'schema',onsp.nspname,'name',oc.opcname,'family_oid',oc.opcfamily,'input_type',oc.opcintype,'default',oc.opcdefault) order by o.pos) from unnest(i.indclass::oid[]) with ordinality o(oid,pos) join pg_opclass oc on oc.oid=o.oid join pg_namespace onsp on onsp.oid=oc.opcnamespace),'collations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('position',co.pos,'oid',co.oid,'metadata',to_jsonb(pc)) order by co.pos) from unnest(i.indcollation::oid[]) with ordinality co(oid,pos) left join pg_collation pc on pc.oid=co.oid),'predicate',pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'expressions',pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid),'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',uc.oid,'name',uc.conname,'type',uc.contype,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(uc.oid,true),'validated',uc.convalidated,'deferrable',uc.condeferrable,'deferred',uc.condeferred) order by uc.oid) from pg_constraint uc where uc.conrelid=c.oid and uc.conindid=i.indexrelid)) order by i.indexrelid) from pg_index i where i.indrelid=c.oid and i.indexrelid in(select f.conindid from pg_constraint f where f.contype='f' and f.confrelid=c.oid and f.conrelid in(to_regclass('public.webhook_subscriptions')))))

) as catalog_receipt;

origin_fk.name: webhook_subscriptions_api_client_id_fkey
origin_fk.definition: FOREIGN KEY (api_client_id) REFERENCES integration_api_clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

referenced_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX integration_api_clients_pkey ON public.integration_api_clients USING btree (id)

boundaries: Only actual webhook_subscriptions_api_client_id_fkey plus integration_api_clients referenced-column/index/constraint metadata. No client rows, keys, tokens or credentials.
